**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear Miss Butler[^2]
It is very kind of you and Mrs Butler but I believe [Miss Mackenzie ](../persons.html#930)is likely to come to me immediately after Lownie’s visit, and as there have been some difficulties about her coming before I could not put it off again.

This is a hurried day so I must only write my thanks

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Evidently before the death of Anne Mackenzie in February 1877.

[^2]: This letter may be addressed to [Anna Butler](../persons.html#237), the sister of CMY\'s friend the Rev.

William Butler, Vicar of Wantage.
